project.name: @senryo/web
project.productType: fintech trading app (Senryo 千両 + Kinpaku 金箔 card, Monad)

direction.name: UGLYCASH
direction.summary: The supplied UGLYCASH native system (89 screenshots, docs/design/reference-study-2026-10-07-uglycash/): a #F5F5F5 canvas, white cards, #ECECEC insets, black primary actions, #FA00FF only for trade, publish and selected controls (black label) and limited glow, green and red only for direction, strongly condensed display type for money and page titles. Senryo's seal and gold leaf are the identity inside it. Tradash sets the live loop's behaviour.
direction.approved: D-304 (user, 10 Oct 2026, replan plan default 6); docs/plan/uglycash-revamp-2026-10-07.md (user "lgtm", 7 Oct 2026); replan R2
direction.supersedes: Living Lacquer (D-168/D-191/D-253) and D2 Desk (D-004) — history only
direction.web: The web carries the same tokens and faces as the phone (replan R2); the desktop rail and drawers are declared adaptations of the phone's dock and sheets.

fonts.sans: Inter 400/500/600/700 (Inter 4.1 static TTF, rsms/inter, OFL) — UI
fonts.display: Inter Display SemiBold (Inter 4.1 static) — big numbers and titles ≥ 32 pt, −0.02 em
fonts.jp: Noto Sans JP, subset to the glyphs we ship (千両金箔), OFL — Japanese only; the seal stays vector

typography.figures: tabular + lining (tnum, lnum) for money, quotes, fees and aligned columns

roles.legacy: micro/label/caption 12/16 · body/bodyStrong 16/22 · title 20/24 · numSm 16/20 · numMd 20/24 · numTicker/numLg 40/44 · numXl/numHero 52/56

radius.use: chips · inputs · action rows · cards and sheet tops · onboarding hero · buttons, dock, fan, avatars
radius.compat: RADIUS.sm = 12 for components not rebuilt yet
radius.tailwind: rounded-xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 24 · xl/2xl/3xl 32 · full pill (globals.css)

families.fan: 200 ms/item, 25 ms stagger, spring 1/420/30; Send overshoots; backdrop 160; plus→× 180 (45°); exit 180 (M06)

motion.reducedMotion: static art, ~100 ms crossfades; reduced transparency → opaque glass/fan backdrop
motion.haptics: selection ticks, one on submit, one on the confirmed outcome; no sound by default
motion.web: durations as --motion-* vars; ease-lacquer (ease-desk is the legacy alias)

must: Reference evidence first: every component names its C/F/M evidence IDs and declared deviations here before it is built
Colours only from @senryo/tokens (theme/ on mobile, tokens.css on web); no hex/rgba elsewhere
Known entities render their real first-party mark (EntityMark, @senryo/identity); Lucide icons identify actions only
Mode capsule ('Practice · Paper money' violet / 'Mainnet · Real money' blue) on every money surface; P$ for paper
Success only after finalization; the 500 ms hold confirms (D-177) with an accessible explicit alternative
Reading<T>: skeleton → value → stale/unavailable; never a fabricated $0.00 or tick
Content padded clear of the dock; tab, stack and scroll restored; parents restored after every sheet
avoid: D2 terminal identity: pure black, monospace amounts, green/yellow primaries, 4 px corners, hairline grids, tracked caps
universal sheet blur, literal radial fans, flat-logo 'material' wobble
success flourishes on submit; celebratory motion before the real outcome
generic coins, letter discs or recoloured approximations for known entities
an available component dictating layout or dropping states (C40 is never a plain slider)
fictitious 21st attribution for a custom reconstruction
framer-motion imports (use motion/react on web); floats for money

materials.glass: dock only (expo-glass-effect on iOS 26; blur + glassTint elsewhere; glassOpaque under reduced transparency)
materials.blur: strong live blur only behind the fan (expo-blur) + fanScrim
materials.dim: ordinary sheets dim the parent (sheetScrim); no universal sheet blur
materials.elevation: dock 0/8/24 #00000033; sheet 0/−4/16 #0000001F; raised content has no shadow
materials.gold: gold identifies Senryo and Kinpaku; never buy, profit, warning or mainnet

decisions.decision: D2 Desk adopted; components from the D2 21st set, re-tokenized to @senryo/tokens

S6 auth surfaces from 21st: Passkey Sign-In #19045 + Push Approval #19036 (felipemenezes098 family, the D2 preview's auth pieces), Text Shimmer #1641, Encrypted Text #18575, shadcn Dialog; composed with the installed Task Steps, Drawer, Segmented Control, QR Code Generator, Copy Code
Tokens moved to Living Lacquer; web layouts follow in S11b

Web parity round 3 (claude/web3): Practice swap at par, B4 deposit address + Arriving, Pay with on the ticket and the pool, the Mainnet network fee planned with every review. No new 21st installs: the searches returned boxed cards and payment forms; built from the installed dotted QR, action circles, stepper and a new AssetChip
S6.3/S6.4: the S22 shell from Mitoshi (rail, top line, stage, dock, Everything) on Radix; ⌘K from 21st originui/command (cmdk); bottom sheets removed from web (vaul dropped)

R2: one UGLYCASH palette for web and phone (@senryo/tokens takes the phone's values; Living Lacquer deleted); the web light by default; Roboto Condensed Black for money and page titles on both; the landing on the same tokens

rules: D-033 as amended by D-168: Reference evidence first; 21st.dev first among component sources that preserve that evidence. RN ports and reference-native reconstructions are recorded here, with evidence IDs, provenance and declared deviations.
no hex/px literals in web components — use tokens (invariant design-literals-web)
